candidates.change_summary: Make paused() return the inverted paused flag (negate the stored _paused value) so callers get the opposite paused status.
Make paused() always return true regardless of the stored _paused flag.
Make paused() always return false regardless of the stored _paused flag.
Make paused() return the value of _initializing (internal Initializable flag) instead of _paused, exposing a different boolean.
Replace setting lrtConfig = ILRTConfig(lrtConfigAddr) with assigning address zero, causing updateLRTConfig to set lrtConfig to zero address instead of provided address.
Replace setting lrtConfig to the provided address with leaving lrtConfig unchanged (no assignment), so updateLRTConfig no longer updates the stored config.
Change onlyLRTAdmin modifier to perform role check against LRTConstants.MANAGER instead of DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, altering who is authorized to call updateLRTConfig.
Set maxNodeDelegatorCount to 0 instead of 10 in initialize, changing observed value after initialize.
Set maxNodeDelegatorCount to 20 instead of 10 in initialize, changing observed value after initialize.
Delete the assignment to maxNodeDelegatorCount so it remains default (0) after initialize, changing observed value.

In initializer modifier, remove the line that sets _initialized = 1 so initialize won't mark contract initialized and initializer will allow reentrancy into initialization path, changing observed state set during initialize (maxNodeDelegatorCount may not be set as expected on subsequent calls).
